purpose: diagnostic only: fixed-input / fixed-routing local sensitivity of the effective GPTQ expert weights; no allocator, no tuning, nothing selected on these windows

FR.provenance: saved by diagnostics/batch_sensitivity.py (FR_ORIGINAL), verified there against runs_partial_ppl

FC.provenance: saved by diagnostics/batch_sensitivity.py (FC_ORIGINAL), verified there against runs_partial_ppl

SC.provenance: regenerated here (stage scweights) with the unchanged E3 solver from the frozen SC s0 selection

capture: BF16 full model, sequential forward of all 128 protocol windows in the PPL evaluator's batches of 8 (identical activations to the PPL run); forward hooks on the 4 Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlocks; data kept for the selected windows only

precision.primary: expert MLPs recomputed in FP32 from BF16 inputs and BF16-stored weights (original / effective GPTQ); router weights = the BF16-cast values the model multiplies by; all squared-error sums accumulated in FP64
precision.secondary: the same metrics with BF16-native expert compute (BF16 matmuls, as the module runs)

metrics.B0: per expert: sum_t ||f_Q(x_t) - f_BF16(x_t)||^2 / sum_t ||f_BF16(x_t)||^2 over its routed eval tokens; reported as the equal-expert mean over 240 experts (and pooled)
metrics.B1: sum_{L,t} sum_{e in top4} w^2 ||delta_e||^2 / sum_{L,t} ||m_BF16||^2  (uncancelled router-weighted energy)
metrics.B2: sum_{L,t} ||sum_e w delta_e||^2 / sum_{L,t} ||m_BF16||^2, m_BF16 = sum_e w f_BF16_e  (PRIMARY; routed experts only, shared expert excluded)
metrics.B3: cancellation ratio = sum ||sum_e w delta_e||^2 / sum sum_e w^2 ||delta_e||^2  (= B2 / B1)
metrics.P_seq: E3 projection objective on the SAME WikiText tokens: per expert, mean over windows of the relative gate/up/down projection error (down input = reference h); equal-expert mean (bridges R0 and B0)

analysis: relative within-metric change vs FR; paired window bootstrap (10,000) of B2 / B1 / pooled B0 differences (descriptive: 32 windows, one allocation seed)
